title: CAPTCHA Handling for BrowserSkill with CapSolver
problem_statement: An authorized BrowserSkill task needs a bounded way to handle a CAPTCHA checkpoint without losing session context.
audience: developers building authorized BrowserSkill QA and RPA workflows
business_outcome: preserve session context, enforce one attempt, and stop safely for human help
implementation_target: companion integration using the verified bsk CLI lifecycle and request-help fallback
